new_findings.title: Observe-only remote evidence can still mutate local detection policy
new_findings.recommendation: Assign immutable transport origin/authority outside peer-controlled details, default-deny observe-only evidence in every state-mutating subscriber, and require a typed local Posture Hardening verification receipt before Evolution may activate or replace rules.

prior_verification.note: SOAR process/file actions and Evolution policy mutation reject observe-only remote evidence.
Staged, executed, and verified states are distinct and rendered truthfully.
AI outage and no-fix outcomes cannot bulk-suppress KEVs.
Production sensors stay active and hanging child tests are deadline-terminated.
Release CI wheels, exact Inno compiler, and CPython 3.12 x64 elevated source bootstraps are hash-pinned with no unhashed dependency fallback.
The first public release boundary has a monotonic Setup gate and no older public release currently exists.
Every self-elevating launcher overwrites inherited ANGERONA_DATA before elevation.
AnalysisWorker payload and native completion signals are separated; native completion owns cleanup.
